id.description: Public mention id in the form "men_{n}".
Public entity id in the form "ent_{n}".

type.description: Entity type. Values: person (an individual), organization (a company or institution; legacy entities may read company or brand), product (a product or service), topic (a subject or theme), channel (a media source such as a YouTube channel), unknown (type was never classified).

slug.description: URL slug, the site's canonical id for every type but channel. Null when never slugged.

page.description: The entity's page on arcmira.com, absolute. Link the name to it when you write the entity into an answer. Null for a type the site has no page for.

title.description: Video title. Null when the video was indexed without metadata.

published_at.description: Video publish timestamp. Null when unknown.

channel_id.description: YouTube channel id of the source channel. Null when unknown.

view_count.description: Video view count at index time. Null when never fetched.

id.description: Public entity id ("ent_{n}") of the source channel.

url.description: Source channel URL. Null when unknown.

source_channel.description: The channel entity that published the video. Null when the video has not been linked to a channel entity.

start_seconds.description: Start position in the video in integer seconds. 0 means "full episode / no specific moment". Null when the analyzer could not place it in time.

end_seconds.description: End position in the video in integer seconds. 0 means "full episode / no specific moment". Null when the analyzer could not place it in time.

is_appearance.description: True when the person physically appears/speaks in the media (person entities only). Always false for organization, product, topic, and channel entities. Filtering with is_appearance=true on a non-person entity returns a 400 (appearances_person_only).

description.description: One-sentence description of the mention context. Null when not generated.

confidence.description: Analyzer confidence between 0 and 1. Null for legacy mentions analyzed before confidence scoring.

sentiment_score.description: Raw sentiment score between -1 and 1. Null when sentiment was not computed for this mention.

sentiment.description: Derived sentiment label from sentiment_score. Values: positive (score above 0.2), negative (score below -0.2), neutral (score between -0.2 and 0.2 inclusive, or no score computed).

referenced_url.description: URL referenced in the mention. Null unless one was extracted.

referenced_platform.description: Platform referenced in the mention, e.g. "twitter". Null unless one was extracted.

extracted_content.description: Verbatim content extracted for the mention. Null unless extraction ran.

id.description: Public recommendation id in the form "com_{n}".

class.description: Commercial class. Values: sponsored (an ad-style promotion heard at that moment: a paid sponsor read, promo code, affiliate plug, thanks for supplied goods or venue, or a show promoting its own product as an ad), organic (an unpaid personal recommendation), mention (a neutral commercial mention).

verbatim_quote.description: Verbatim quote from the transcript. Null when no quote was extracted.

promo_code.description: Promo code read out in the mention. Null unless one was detected.

offer.description: Offer text, e.g. "20% off". Null unless one was detected.

start_seconds.description: Start position in the video in integer seconds. 0 means "full episode / no specific moment". Null when the analyzer could not place it in time.

end_seconds.description: End position in the video in integer seconds. 0 means "full episode / no specific moment". Null when the analyzer could not place it in time.

items.description: Commercial mentions (sponsored and organic) for the same entity in the same video.

recommendations.description: Only present when the request used details=full (requires a Pro+ plan).
